packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps: 6 of the 8 action refs live in build.yml, so separate PRs conflict with each other
The Go version lives in go.mod, the Dockerfile builder tag and the devcontainer image. CI fails if go.mod and the Dockerfile disagree, so they must move in one PR

docker-compose.description: docker-compose.yml references the locally built image (build: .), not an upstream tag
